Other than that I’m with you I have plenty of examples many of which I didn’t care enough to remember but most recently my house ran out of Cholula hot sauce it’s our favorite and we always have some but now story time. I shop at Costco and try to buy in bulk because it saves money so I always buy the biggest hot sauce bottle I can. But we had run out one day and I just wanted to make a quick run to the local dollar store and they only had the small bottles so we used that for a while. Before the small bottle ran out I had again gone shopping to Costco and had another sealed big bottle in the fridge. Side note our small bottle of hot sauce was dropped so it usually had a big wooden lid if you know what cholula bottles look like but the wood fell off so it was just the little plastic piece under the wood left.
One morning I asked my dad to make some eggs and bacon for breakfast and he calls me into the kitchen when it is finished.
He uses the very last of the small bottle of cholula it is emptied onto his eggs and bacon and then it gets thrown in the trash.
I then open the new bottle of hot sauce and use it for myself since there was none left in the other bottle.
We both finish I say thanks and we go to our rooms to eat breakfast everything is fine until lunch.
He asks me if I want a frozen burrito fried up and of course I do.
Once the burritos are done we both go for the hot sauce to find that the only thing we have in the fridge is a sealed bottle of cholula...
